title: Fix Theta* skipping expansion of the last popped open-set node by Grices · Pull Request #6401 · ros-navigation/navigation2 · GitHub
body_rendered_text:
Fixes #6398


generatePath expanded the current node before popping the next open-set

node. After the last remaining node was popped, the queue was empty so the

loop exited without setNeighbors or isGoal on that node.


This could return a false no-path when that node was the goal or the only

8-connected gateway out of a pocket.


Pop the next node at the start of the loop, then expand or accept it as the

goal. Keep the existing cancel_checker handling.

Pull request overview


This pull request fixes a correctness bug in nav2_theta_star_planner’s Theta* implementation where ThetaStar::generatePath() could exit when the open set became empty without ever checking/expanding the last popped node, causing false “no path” results in edge cases.


Changes:



Refactors the main search loop to pop the next open-set node at the start of each iteration, then evaluate it (goal check) and expand it (neighbor generation).


Converts the goal-detection path to an immediate success return after backtrace() and clearQueue(), ensuring the final popped node is handled correctly.


Simplifies the post-loop logic so that exhausting the queue deterministically returns failure (raw_path.clear(); return false;).
